svg.text: w and f both injective. Every one has L_ph Latin and all three row sums 15.
Grouped by (sgn w, sgn f) — all four combinations occur, 9 seeds each. Digit colour = phase.
The canonical increasing-through-1 seeds 159 and 168 are ringed; both sit in the f-even column.
36 = 3! x 3! — one injective orbit word times one injective phase word. All 36 are row-magic 15; none is magic.
